lines.en: label halloweenfour7:
scene norikutaikuioween1
: Rich families sure do have some weird taste in decor, don’t they?
: What do you think they are?
: They look kinda like...monks. But I’m not really sure how that would fit in with the Halloween motif.

: The great thing about the Halloween motif is that anything can fit in with it. Which is why it’s acceptable for you to be a pirate and for me to be a girl who occasionally wakes up in the body of a man.
: Lucky. I’ve always wondered what it would be like to have a wiener.
: Yeah, they look fun. I feel like they’d be uncomfortable to carry around everywhere, though.
: I can’t imagine it’s any less comfortable than Aunt Flow coming to visit once a month.
: Word.
: So is this just what we’re going to do for the rest of the night? Comment on the Amamiya family’s decor and talk about wieners?
: Well, what else are we supposed to do while we patiently wait for the guy we like to acknowledge us?
scene norikutaikuioween2
: I’m afraid I don’t know what you mean, Noriko. I haven’t liked anyone since the crush I had on Io back when I thought she was a boy.
: Do you ever get exhausted? Having to ignore it, I mean.
: Ignore what? I do not like anyone, so I do not know what you are referring to.
: Well, let’s assume that you hypothetically do like someone. And that person just so happens to be the same person that someone very close to you also likes.
: How long do you think it would take you to, like...give up?
: I suppose that depends entirely on how much I hypothetically like this hypothetical person.

: Then, how long do you think it would take for you to start feeling tired and helpless? Or like you’re trying to run through quicksand because you never learned how it works and are now face to face with death.
: Is that you how you feel, Noriko?
: Yeah.
: Yeah, it is.
: I don’t want to speak for you, but I’m exhausted.
: I keep telling myself all of this stuff about how I’m going to be the one to take a step forward but, when push comes to shove, all I do is stand still and wait for him to...back up.
: Standing still beats walking away. Which is probably what I’d hypothetically do in this hypothetical scenario.
: It kind of sucks that we have to go through all this extra shit just because we’re selfless, doesn’t it?
scene norikutaikuioween3
: You really think that’s it?
: What else would it be? It’s not like we’re bad people.
: What’s that thing Christians have to do to make up for their sins or whatever? Pennants...or something?
scene norikutaikuioween4
: Penance. But what does that have to do with anything? Because I have a hard time believing someone like you has done anything to warrant drowning yourself in Our Fathers.
: Keep your dad away from me. I’m just saying that...hypothetically, if I was ever in the kind of situation you’re talking about, I’d probably just assume it was punishment for something I did.
: Do you believe in that kind of stuff? God...spirituality...whatever you want to call it?
scene norikutaikuioween5
: I think so.
: But sometimes I feel like I only think that way because I’m afraid of what would happen if none of it’s true.
: Like, what if we really are just...alone? What if this is all we get?
: If this is all we get, it makes the way we’re acting now all the more terrifying.
scene norikutaikuioween6
: It really does...doesn’t it?
: Hypothetically, I mean.
: How long have you loved him?
: Not nearly as long as you.
scene norikutaikuioween7
: So what? It’s not like that gives me dibs on his heart.
: I know...I know. I just...
: I feel like...saying anything at all about this while standing next to you will make me sound like an idiot when you’ve been down bad for the guy since before Aunt Flow even met you.
: Again...so what?

: Do you really think I’m the type of person to think less of you for your feelings? You or anyone else could probably spit in my face and I’d still jump in front of a train for you because I’m an idiot.
scene norikutaikuioween8
: How long have you known?...About me, I mean. And...the way I feel? Because I haven’t even told Io yet.
: When you spend as much time in front of the mirror as I do, you wind up getting a little too familiar with how it looks to be in love.
scene norikutaikuioween9
: And I figured if it was going to be anyone from the class, it’d be him.
: How’d you figure that? I like girls too, you know.
: Because it’s always him.
: You know, maybe this is my penance.
: Maybe in some other life, I did something really terrible.
: And God’s way of making me pay for it is by forcing me to watch everyone I know fall for the same person I fell for...
: And giving me everything I could ever need in life except the one thing I want.
: Courage.
: The ability to actually do something.
: You’ve done way more than I have, Noriko. You’ve been chasing after the guy for years. That takes guts. That takes strength.
: And yet, we’re both in the same exact position...Staring up at the same weird statue and waiting for the same weird guy to come up to us and tell us he’s made a choice.
: So, I’ll ask you again-
: Do you ever get exhausted? Having to ignore it.
: Does it ever tire you out pretending that everything’s okay when you know it’s not?
: Does it hurt having to trick yourself into thinking this is just how this kind of stuff is supposed to work? And that it’ll all be over before you know it?
scene norikutaikuioween10
: Yeah.
: It’s way harder than I ever expected it to be. And I feel like I barely even know him, so I can only imagine what it’s like for you.
: You don’t need to imagine it. You already feel it. And I’m sure it stings just as much for you as it does for me.
: I’ve just had the misfortune of feeling that sting a few more times.
scene norikutaikuioween11
: Noriko...can I ask you something?
: Of course.
: Why are you being so nice to me about this? Shouldn’t you be at least a little upset that I’m pining after the same guy as you? Cause you’re practically giving me a pep-talk here.
: It’s not practically, Uta. That’s exactly what I’m doing.

: You and I are cut from the same cloth. And somewhere along the inseam, we decided it was okay to suffer so long as it meant those we care about could get a little reprieve from the pain of falling in love.
: And, like the martyr I am, that’s exactly what I’m doing for you. But it’s not out of necessity or some sort of ingrained responsibility that I just decided to have one day.
: I want you to be happy.
: And it will never be my place to tell you that you can’t.
scene norikutaikuioween12
: Chin up, kid.
: You’ve got a long ride ahead of you.
: Thank you...
: You know...things have been really hard lately.
: And every single day, I tell myself they’re going to get better or easier, but...they never do.
: But even with all of the pain I...the pain we’ve felt along the way...
: There’s one thing that holds true.
scene black
: I’m glad our other school disappeared.
: And I’m glad to have met all of you.
scene norikutaikuioween13
Two girls place.
One green, one brownish. Both small.
One like the sex, other like the hammer.
They have talk about a thing they got in common.
Good talk about a bad thing.
Miku make the word feel light, Io make the light feel dark.
Anyway here’s the rest of scene.
Please don’t mind the rabbit.
: So, how’s it feel to be an official member of the purely transactional “Feelings in Exchange for Pills” club?
: Kinda weird, not gonna lie. I ain’t ever been good at, like...actually talkin’ about stuff. But the doctor says it’s okay if I go at my own pace for a while.
: The trick is to drag that out for as long as possible and then swap therapists right when they start to be all like “Grrr you still haven’t told me anything yet!”
: That way, you can perpetually avoid ever having to open up to anyone while still gaining all of the benefits of being properly medicated. Hooray.
: So, what do they have you on? Is it the same thing I was giving you?
: I don’t think so...but I can’t really pronounce whatever it is.
: Is it working? You seem fine right now. But I also seem fine a lot of the time when, on the inside, I’m like four hours into a panic attack.
scene norikutaikuioween14
: It definitely ain’t as strong, but...I think that might be kinda good since I got a little...carried away with the other stuff after a while.
: The doctor says I might have to try a few different things before I find the “right one for me.” But I ain’t really sure how long that’s supposed to take.
: Anywhere from a few weeks to years. But hey, here’s hoping it’s not the latter.
: Yeah...here’s hoping.
: Welp, I guess that’s the end of Dr. Io. Sensei’s sure to be happy. I feel like he was getting close to disowning me.
scene norikutaikuioween15
: Make that two of us. I can’t remember much’a what happened when things got really bad, but I do remember sayin’ a bunch of messed up stuff to him and, like...kinda blamin’ him a little bit.
: Yeah, drugs’ll do that. When they first started putting me on stuff, I wound up mixing meds when I wasn’t supposed to and threatened to kill my aunt after getting a little too messed up one night.
scene norikutaikuioween16
: Jesus. That sounds a little intense for just mixin’ up some pills.

: Yeah, well when you’re bite-sized like us, a little too much of anything could send you spiraling into chaos. Or even death. But hey, my aunt is alive and so am I. So everything worked out in the end.
scene norikutaikuioween17
: Either way...I should probably say thank you and stuff. Cause if it weren’t for you, I ain’t sure if I’d even be seein’ a doctor right now. Ya kinda, like...opened my eyes or somethin’.
: Just don’t repeat any of that to Makoto cause she’s super pissed and doesn’t know you’re the person who was givin’ me stuff in the first place.
: Cool. Though, I’d be lying if I said I didn’t expect her to figure it out sooner or later based on limited context and the fact that you are currently talking to me in a crowded room.
scene norikutaikuioween18
: You’ve got a good point there. We should probably keep away from each other for a little while if we don’t want her catchin’ on.
: Luckily for you, keeping away from people is my specialty. You won’t even remember I exist by the end of the night.
: Really though, Io...thank you.
: I know this probably ain’t how you imagined this goin’ in the end, but ya really did set me on the right path. Ya just...didn’t do it how you were supposed to, I think.
: For the record, this is pretty much exactly how I imagined this going. But I’m glad you’re doing a little better now.
: And I’m also excited to have somebody to talk about medications with! I’ll be the first to admit that they’re scary as hell at first, but crazy interesting once you start learning about them.
: Yeah, I...I don’t really think my brain’s capable of understandin’ any of that stuff just yet. I can’t even read most of the words on the bottle.
scene norikutaikuioween19
: There’s no need to rush. It’s not like anyone’s going to steal me away from you or anything when I’m probably the least desirable person in all of Kumon-mi.
: They just ain’t seein’ the real you yet, Io.
: No, that would be a good thing. The real me is the one that repels people. I’m like...manganese oxide polystyrene. But with green hair and girl parts.
: M...Mango...oxen...poly...stream?
: It’s used to make hydrophobic coatings for glass and stuff. Water can’t stick to it. That’s me saying it’s physically impossible for anyone to get attached to me.
: I don’t know about that, Io. You and Uta seem pretty attached from what I’ve seen so far.
scene norikutaikuioween20
: Yeah...
: But she’ll leave me someday.
: Or rather...she should leave me someday.
: Now, why the heck would ya go and say somethin’ like that? That ain’t right, Io. That’s just sad.
: It is sad, isn’t it?
: But...do you know what’s even worse, Miku?
: The fact that someone like her...
: Someone so beautiful and kind and entirely unbiased...
: Would ever end up with me in the first place.
scene black
: All I’ll ever do is hold her back.
